programme.desc: S02 E14 — Yeti Sighting; Italian UFO Discusses whether a bipedal figure that crossed a snowy field is a fabled yeti; also explores the history of UFOs in Italy and if a creature peeking around the corner is a real-life alien.
programme.title: The Proof Is Out There

programme.desc: S02 E15 — Snakelike Sea Monster; North Korean Supersoldier A sighting of a 30-foot-long serpentine sea monster; recordings of strange howls of the Wendigo from indigenous American folklore; Tony Harris and his team of experts investigate these claims.
programme.title: The Proof Is Out There

programme.desc: A Haunted Stadium & More A security guard confronts a terrifying shadow person in an empty stadium; a man in Utah spots a fleet of UFOs; a lake monster threatens to devour a group of swimmers in Chile.
programme.title: Paranormal Caught on Camera

programme.desc: Here begins as a hunt for a paranormal research facility in America's most haunted state turns into a journey filled with discoveries for a team of supernatural investigators.
programme.title: Haunted Discoveries

programme.desc: S01 E01 — New York Superstorms New York City is under attack as Hurricanes Ida and Ian unleash their fury on innocent people; seeing how the latest science and technology can protect New York City's 8 million residents before everything gets swept away by ferocious superstorms.
programme.title: Brink of Disaster

programme.desc: S02 E03 — Dark Entities Discovering evil beings that hide in the shadows, waiting for a chance to pounce; seeing why a Pennsylvania well is a gateway to terror; crossing paths with an otherworldly stalker in Georgia; exorcize a dark spirit in a South Carolina family home.
programme.title: My Haunted Hometown

programme.desc: S01 E06 — Charleston Buccaneers who ran a South Carolina port in the golden age of piracy are summoned; the truth about a ghost ship and a creepy bedroom in the city's oldest tavern is uncovered; a spirit stalking one of the investigators is confronted.
programme.title: Destination Haunted

programme.desc: S01 E01 — Pirate Skeletons & Fairy Coffins Learn who sailed on a sunken, treasure-filled pirate ship and who invoked the devil on a medieval curse tablet; Investigate 17 mini-coffins that have puzzled Scottish historians since 1836 and look inside a mysterious well of bones in Athens.
programme.title: Secrets In The Dark

programme.desc: S04 E03 — Desert Mysteries Investigate an abandoned village in the shifting sands on Dubai's outskirts and a collection of inexplicable stone circles in Colombia; a mysterious hilltop tower in Iran and a puzzling purple phenomenon in Chile's Atacama Desert.
programme.title: Mysteries From Above

programme.desc: S01 E05 — Territorial Spirits Three people encounter spirits intent on reclaiming their space, at any cost to the humans who have intruded.
programme.title: Paranormal Survivor

programme.desc: S02 E16 — Nessie's Cousin and NYC UFOs Boaters claim to have captured footage of a real-life cousin to Nessie; questions if glowing orbs floating above NYC are cause for concern.
programme.title: The Proof Is Out There

programme.desc: S02 E17 — Mutant Mummy & Alien Monolith A small, human-like creature; loud booms plaguing the area of New Jersey; monoliths popping up all over the world; Tony Harris and his team examine the evidence to determine which of these sightings are truly unexplained.
programme.title: The Proof Is Out There

programme.desc: A Boys School With a Dark Past & More Ghost hunters contact a dead employee, who was accused of heinous crimes, from an abandoned youth center; a family crosses paths with Bigfoot deep in the woods of Canada; the ghost of a small child runs through a Savannah cemetery.
programme.title: Paranormal Caught on Camera

programme.desc: S01 E04 — Hairdresser Fury (The Joleen Cummings story) Examining the evil acts that Jennifer Sybert, a hairdresser in Florida, tried to keep hidden from her colleague, top stylist Joleen Cummings; an entanglement with Joleen's ex blows the lid off Jennifer's criminal past, and leads to a ghastly slaying.
programme.title: A Secret to Die For

programme.desc: S01 E02 — Alien Invasion In July 1947, visitors to the south of Roswell described stumbling upon a crashed UFO; some witnesses even claim to have seen the bodies of aliens; their historic testimony has been dismissed for decades.
programme.title: Roswell: The Final Verdict

programme.desc: S01 E04 — Paul Bennewitz and Project Seven Lambs In 1978, UFO enthusiast Paul Bennewitz claims he's intercepted extraterrestrial messages; military officials send counterintelligence officer Richard Doty to feed Bennewitz lies, questioning whether Doty himself is a pawn in an even bigger scheme.
programme.title: Alien Files Reopened

programme.desc: S04 E22 — Mysterious Monoliths All over the world, there are giant monoliths that ancient ancestors carved out of solid rock.
programme.title: The UnXplained

programme.title: The Proof Is Out There

programme.title: Forbidden Love

programme.title: Dr. Pimple Popper

programme.title: Dr. Pimple Popper

programme.title: Dr. Pimple Popper

programme.title: Untold Stories of the E.R.
